tools.name: Spira Maxima
tools.tagline: Video model that turns script into viral social media videos
tools.description: Spira Maxima turns plain text into a finished social video: presenter, on-trend B-roll, captions and music in one pass, ready to post with nothing to re-edit. Bring a photo and voice for your AI clone, product shots, or a recording, and it builds the edit around you. Post-trained on social trend and performance data, so every video follows what is working to maximize your social impact.

tools.name: Pancake
tools.tagline: The Vercel for GTM
tools.description: Pancake is the Vercel for GTM. It gives you the building blocks to deploy any go-to-market idea from your favorite AI agent, such as Claude or Codex: a GTM Brain, sending infrastructure, and 40+ data providers and enrichment, all accessible through one MCP connection.

tools.name: ReSO AI
tools.tagline: Get discovered & recommended when customers ask AI
tools.description: ReSO is a generative engine optimization platform that helps brands show up in AI search results. It’s built for founders, CMOs, and growth teams who want to turn buyer intent in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AIO into visibility, citations, and traffic. What makes it different is that it doesn’t just track rankings, it analyzes intent, competitors, content gaps, and technical issues, then turns them into priority actions to improve AI recommendations.

tools.name: IrisGo for Solopreneurs
tools.tagline: AI workflow automation: show it once, let it run
tools.description: IrisGo helps solopreneurs automate recurring work. Get daily briefs, triage email, track to-dos, and turn demonstrated tasks into reusable workflows with Watch & Learn. Spend less time on admin and more time building your business. Free during beta.

tools.name: Rill Browser
tools.tagline: The browser where Claude Code and Codex work beside you
tools.description: Rill is an AI-native browser built around the Claude Code and Codex you already use. Browse normally, then press ⌘E on any page to turn what you're looking at into a task for your agent. Rill finds the right project, passes along the context, and the agent works while you keep browsing. It also sorts your tabs into themes, turns your history into days you can search, and brings every project your agents are working on into one place. Free, on the plan you already have.

tools.name: Velozity
tools.tagline: The Multiplayer AI Office where your team and agents work
tools.description: Your team chats in one app, meets in another, and every AI works alone. Velozity brings it all into one place. Chat, audio and video calls with transcripts, tasks, calendar and files, plus AI agents (Claude, Codex, etc.) on the subscriptions you already pay for. Every agent shares the same context, so work moves between people and agents without having to re-explain. For startups, teams in dev, product, sales, and ops, or solo users juggling several AIs. No second AI bill. Free to start.

tools.name: Pexo
tools.tagline: Produce pitch perfect launch videos with precise control
tools.description: Pexo makes creating your launch video as simple as having a conversation. Share your product, website, or assets. It plans the story, chooses the right AI model for each task, generates and assembles the scenes, and handles voiceover, music, captions, motion graphics, and editing. Leave a comment or circle what you want changed, and Pexo makes the edit. You direct one agent from idea to a finished, on-brand launch video.

tools.name: MCP Connectors by Databox
tools.tagline: Give your AI Analyst context to explain performance and act
tools.description: Connect your AI Analyst to the tools your business runs on. It pulls context from your CRM or support desk, so every answer reflects what's happening in your business, and it can act on what it finds. Choose from 10+ connectors or add any MCP server.

tools.name: Floot MCP
tools.tagline: Build and ship web and mobile apps inside Claude or ChatGPT
tools.description: Connect Floot to Claude or ChatGPT and build a full-stack app without leaving the chat. Floot gives your AI a ready-to-use workspace with a database, user logins, hosting, and a live URL - nothing to install or configure. Your existing Claude or ChatGPT subscription does the thinking, so Floot doesn’t charge based on AI usage. When you’re ready, publish the same project to the web, iOS, and Android, then keep shipping updates from the same conversation.

tools.name: Ferndesk
tools.tagline: The help center that never goes out of date
tools.description: Ferndesk is a complete help center with an agent that checks every article against your product, catches what changed, and drafts the fixes for you.

tools.name: iFixAi
tools.tagline: Independent auditing of AI agents to uncover misalignment
tools.description: iFixAi is an independent auditor helping companies assess whether they can trust their AI agents. Unlike relying solely on evals and observability tools, its multifaceted audit includes 250 inspections across 69 categories of AI misalignment, combining AI red teaming, operational assurance, and philosophical, ethical, and sociological perspectives. It identifies failures under testing, explains their business implications, and provides evidence engineers can use to investigate and fix them.

tools.name: Inbox Zero
tools.tagline: Open-source Superhuman alternative
tools.description: Inbox Zero Mail is an open-source email client for Gmail and Outlook. Fast, keyboard-first, and free to use, on web, Mac, Windows and iPhone, with all your accounts in one inbox. Add AI for $20/mo: every email is sorted, and replies are drafted in your voice before you open them. Comment privately with your team, get Slack alerts, and give the AI context from your tools.

tools.name: Beam.win
tools.tagline: Run AI agents on one Mac and use its windows on another
tools.description: Keep your agents and builds running on a Mac mini or Studio. Beam brings their Terminal, browser and other app windows onto the Mac in front of you, each as its own window with a Dock icon and ⌘Tab presence. Encrypted between your Macs. Free to try.

tools.name: GPT-6 Sol & Luna
tools.tagline: Frontier AI intelligence, now at half the price
tools.description: OpenAI expands the GPT-6 family with Sol and Luna with faster, cheaper models trained like Astra. 50% lower API pricing, near-Astra factuality/coding/computer use gains, better prompt caching (90% off cached reads), and alignment improvements. Live in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and via API.

tools.name: Jockey by TwelveLabs
tools.tagline: Your entire video library: organized, searchable, understood
tools.description: Jockey is the first AI that understands your entire media library across photos and video. It analyzes thousands of hours of footage so you can find and connect people, moments and context across videos. Use it in Claude or ChatGPT, or build with the API/SDK. Ingest YouTube, TikTok and Instagram Reels links; assemble content into MP4s; and create and share video-driven artifacts with playable clips. Every TwelveLabs model upgrade makes Jockey better, without re-integration.

tools.name: Claude Haiku 5.5
tools.tagline: Anthropic's fastest and most capable Haiku yet
tools.description: Claude Haiku 5.5 is Anthropic's fastest and most capable small model, built for high-volume, cost-sensitive tasks like summarization, classification, coding subagents, customer support, and browser use.

tools.name: Opengeni
tools.tagline: Ship AI agents within minutes. Infrastructure for Agents
tools.description: Ship AI agents to production in hours. Opengeni gives you sessions that recover from failures, isolated sandboxes, 100+ integrations, human approvals, and visibility into every step and dollar spent. Focus on your agents. We handle the infrastructure. Self-host for free, or get started on our cloud. For this launch, the first 100 users get $100 in cloud credit. Promo-code: PRODUCTHUNT100

tools.name: DeepCell
tools.tagline: Your deadline survival kit for office work
tools.description: Deepcell can help you with deadline tasks that require narrations, calculation and presentation at the same time, such as modeling, sales review, budget forecast and monthly report. DeepCell (both web app and agent plug-in) can create ready-to-use docs, spreadsheets, and slides—with sources and cheat sheets to help you explain. Furthermore, every edit can update related parts. The product is built on a newly designed document format (.deepcell), which is especially designed for system two tasks.

tools.name: Claude Duet
tools.tagline: Proactive agent that understands what needs your attention
tools.description: Claude Duet is a helpful, proactive agent you hand off work to through messages. Tell it what you need and it works on its own computer in the cloud, using apps you connect. It messages you when it is done or needs a decision from you. While it’s always on, it uses good judgment when it reaches out and knows what can wait.

tools.name: Composio Instant
tools.tagline: The easiest way for AI agents to pay for their own tools
tools.description: Give your agent superpowers. No subscriptions, no signups. With Composio Instant, your agent can search the web, find business contacts, create voiceovers, turn audio into text, and so much more. Try it free: composio.dev/instant
